description: Aider-polyglot style (TypeScript): implement a CSV parser from a stub and an instructions file - quoted fields, doubled quotes, line breaks inside quotes kept verbatim, CRLF and LF, lone CR as data, trailing delimiter and trailing newline rules, a configurable delimiter with validation, and CsvError with the 1-based line and column of the opening quote or of the stray character, counted across multi-line fields. The unit tests are the acceptance bar and the post-turn verifier runs them, so a failing first attempt gets a repair round with the test output, like aider's second try.
